limitations: Before/after conditions occupy separate browser sessions; only native/xterm ratios inside each condition are paired.
Ghostty WebGL uses xterm WebGL as a like-for-like backend control; Ghostty WebGPU also uses xterm WebGL because xterm has no WebGPU backend.

CPU values are percentages of one core. Formal output CPU decisions require 100 ticks per side at 10 ms resolution and a difference exceeding one tick; GPU-process ratios have only a descriptive tick-resolution audit.
GPU-process CPU means CPU consumption, not hardware GPU execution time. GPU paired ratio is descriptive and has no formal runner target.
Headless-shell compositor presentation acknowledgement is on-demand, not physical vsync or optical latency.

Latency probes are existing colored-marker writes and # keydown through the local echo socket; output fixture labels do not make those probes Unicode input measurements. This harness does not measure Platform UI or remote-network latency.
No additional attribution-trace window was run; this is the ten-window CPU/latency/frame-counter matrix.
GPU foreign-activity qualification uses resident compute memory as a conservative proxy; utilization includes the benchmark and sampling can miss shorter bursts.
Rolling-unicode-logs is synthetic real-Git-history plus a shell prompt every four source lines and box/CJK text every sixteen; it is not a captured production session.
Frame counters before and after output are cumulative renderer counters; delta isolates timed output. Total after-output counters include correctness, latency, warmup and timed output.
Unicode1 WebGPU and all rolling1 windows skipped by coordinator.

Treatment timings apply to the frozen 7405-byte bridge, SHA-256 ee018ec74ab05f8d0a90732400f6245a994215867dba6b9040558d0ed648a7fe. Commit cd8be0c6b06b8c106ca86a9253ed6efec7fa116b has a later colored-atlas pressure guard, a separate 7408-byte bridge, and is untimed; lead reports byte-identical browser.js, and the sole production TypeScript delta is independently verified erased type annotations.

calculationDefinitions.absoluteWindowValues: Median of four per-run CPU values or per-run latency quantiles; latency samples are not pooled
calculationDefinitions.pairedRatios: Median of four native / xterm values matched by repetition inside a condition
calculationDefinitions.beforeAfterChangesPercent: 100 * (after condition median / before condition median - 1); descriptive across separate sessions
calculationDefinitions.timedFrameCounts: Sum of each terminal renderer counter delta across all terminals; cumulative before/after counters also retained
